name: univer
description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
one_liner: A toolkit developers can drop into their own app to get a real, editable spreadsheet and document editor, so you don't have to build Excel from scratch.
buyer: A SaaS founder building a vertical product, like a restaurant inventory tool or a CRM, who needs built-in spreadsheet editing without licensing or rebuilding Excel.
business_use_cases: A vertical SaaS, like a restaurant inventory tool, embeds it so customers edit a live spreadsheet inside the app instead of exporting to Excel.
An internal-tools team builds a lightweight 'AI office' where support staff and an AI assistant collaboratively edit the same shared document in real time.
An ed-tech company builds a classroom collaborative-spreadsheet product on top of it rather than licensing the Google Sheets API.

money_ideas.idea: Paid implementation and integration consulting for companies embedding it into their product
A narrow vertical micro-SaaS, like a shared restaurant inventory spreadsheet, built on top of it

steal_this: Build a tiny 'shared live inventory spreadsheet for restaurants' micro-SaaS on top of it this weekend.
